metadata.scopeNote: CHSA boundary version 2018: BC Ministry of Health geometry via the Community Map of Canada ArcGIS mirror, reviewed 12 October 2026. Shared-topology display simplification: 50 m. The mirror is licensed for mapping/visualization only; no spatial analysis or allocation is performed. Forty Northern context polygons include 29 publicly listed measured CHSAs. Unreleased communities are not assigned zeros. The legacy official DataBC ZIP is unavailable; no fresh official ZIP verification is claimed.
